reason: B is the more chemically coherent and decisively testable proposal: Co can substitute on the Ni sublattice, and its composition series directly tests mechanical and magnetocaloric trade-offs. Its grain-boundary mechanism remains speculative and Co may strongly shift the magnetostructural transition, but A relies on evidence from an unrelated FCC high-entropy alloy and does not substantiate Ag solubility, grain-boundary cohesion, or retention of the MnNiSi magnetocaloric transition.
